excerpt.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

sections.zh: 易爆微粒月度结余为正

texts.zh: 由于管理缺失和大肆的浪费，我们的易爆微粒库存已经完全枯竭！这种战略资源在包括合金冶炼和军事发展等诸多领域有着广泛的应用。尽快补充库存对确保我们帝国经济繁荣至关重要。
texts.en: Due to mismanagement and reckless expenditures, our Volatile Motes reserves have completely evaporated! This strategic resource is widely used in multiple fields, ranging from alloys production to military development. Replenishing our supplies is of paramount importance to ensure the economic prosperity of our empire.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取易爆微粒。
label.en: Siphon volatile motes from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超罕见”微粒。
label.en: We can live with our motes becoming more elusive.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的经济危机。由于无法弥补赤字，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
texts.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide economic crash. Unable to repay our deficits, we were forced to declare bankruptcy and forfeit on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

texts.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的补给链崩溃。很显然我们已经无法继续维持我们对该物质的消耗。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
texts.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide supply chain crash. It has become clear that we can no longer sustain our use of this material. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

texts.zh: 我们各世界之间易爆微粒的短缺已造成广泛的混乱，尤其是那些生命完全依赖于它的极端微生物共生体。为了防止生命和生产力的进一步损失，我们现在必须实行剧烈的变革，以确保基本生命的延续，希望我们能尽快恢复平衡。
texts.en: The shortage of Volatile Motes among our worlds has caused widespread disruption, not least to those extremophile worker-symbionts whose very lives depend on it. To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now institute drastic change to ensure basic continuity of life, in the hopes we might soon regain equilibrium.

note.en: In the game, the name of your financial advisory office appears here.

summary.text:
# 易爆微粒短缺 / Volatile Motes Shortages
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 资源赤字情境 resource-deficit situation
- 来源 Sources：`common/situations/02_deficit_situations.txt:1951` · `events/situation_deficit_events.txt` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960-3020`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

资源赤字情境是引擎在该资源出现实际赤字时开始的（脚本中没有 start_situation 调用，仅在 `first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020` 等处按类型引用）；初始进度 15，共四个阶段（进度 25 / 50 / 75 / 100），每个阶段的惩罚递增：民用经济外交权重 −10%…−50%、人口组装减慢、舰船伤害与航速 −20%…−80%（非生物舰船）、机械帝国的科研劳动力 −33%…−75%（`02_deficit_situations.txt:1–16, 16–300`）。每月进度：赤字时增加“赤字进度值”，收入不为负时 −5，有库存缓冲时 −1；平民难度 ×0.1、学员难度 ×0.5（对非AI）。进度满即“破产”；情境被中止时按资源给予救助金。 / The engine starts a resource-deficit situation when the country has an actual deficit of that resource (no start_situation call exists in the shipped scripts; only type switches in first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:2960–3020). It begins at progress 15 with four stages (25 / 50 / 75 / 100) whose penalties escalate: diplomatic economy weight −10%…−50%, slower pop assembly, ship damage and speed −20%…−80% (non-bio ships), machine research workforce −33%…−75%. Monthly progress rises with the deficit, falls by 5 when income is not negative and by 1 with a stockpile; civilian difficulty ×0.1, cadet ×0.5 for humans. Full progress is bankruptcy; aborting grants a bailout.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **情境“挥发性微粒短缺”**：路线（approach）：无作为 / 回收利用 / 投资微粒生产者。/ Approaches: do nothing / recycling / invest in mote producers.
2. **进入第四阶段（进度 ≥75）→ deficit.200 严重的挥发性微粒赤字**：A 向支持者借款（仅当统治者有所属派系）/ B 从被掠夺的星球上重新分配资源（需有被掠夺星球）/ C 一切按计划进行。 / A borrow from supporters (needs a ruler faction), B reallocate resources from a looted planet, C everything goes to plan.
3. **进度满 → deficit.205 破产！**：违约并大幅削减开支（意识集合则强制重新分配资源）。/ Progress complete → bankruptcy event deficit.205: the country defaults and makes sharp cutbacks.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

没有分叉结局：要么在进度满前把赤字扭转（情境失败 = 解除），要么破产。/ No branching ending: either the deficit is reversed before completion (the situation fails and ends) or bankruptcy follows.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

意识集合/机械帝国有不同文本与惩罚；破碎枷锁/分离主义者的相关支援会在阶段2–4提供少量资源。/ Gestalt and machine empires have different texts and penalties; separatist help (Fear of the Dark) adds small resources in stages 2–4.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：情境定义、阶段惩罚、进度公式、路线，以及阶段四和破产事件。/ Situation definition, stage penalties, progress formula, approaches and the stage-4 and bankruptcy events.
- 审阅改动 Changes：编译结构正确（情境 → 阶段四事件 → 破产事件）；补充了共同机制与本资源的路线。/ The compiled structure was correct; the shared mechanism and this resource’s approaches are documented.
- 不确定 Uncertain：情境的开始由引擎判定，脚本里看不到。 / The start of the situation is engine-side and not visible in the scripts.
